notes.title: 7 DAYS RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
Hello 7-dayers!



I've got a couple of things to share...




GOOD ROUTE: DONE
The good route of 7 Days is done! Day 1-7 are finished and playtesting has begun! That means work on the other main routes will start soon!!!


7 DAYS RELEASE DATE
7 Days will release on August 30, 2025! Maybe?

That was the plan, but apperently Steam doesn't really let you release on weekends. Damn.

The release on the Steam page has been set to August 29 (for now), but it'll be around that time.


FINAL TRAILER
The final trailer for 7 Days is out! It includes new content from the full game, a banger song (remix of 7 Days by Daver The Dave, feat. Senchu & Jenna), and the release date!

Check it out!
[previewyoutube="VUnLvhl-ERk;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube]















STEAM NEXT FEST
7 Days will be joining June's Steam Next Fest! Hopefully this might bring some new eyes to the game :)

Be sure to let everyone you know about 7 Days, force them to wishlist and download the demo. MAKE THEM PART OF THE 7 DAYS GANG. RAHHHHHHHH


7 DAYS LIVE SOUNDTRACK CONCERT
I'm a music student, and this entire year I had to work on a project to prove I'm worthy of graduating (or something idk). I chose to incorporate my game into this project! I wrote a 50 page essay about evoking emotions in video game music, and recently we played a couple songs from 7 Days live on stage, with background visuals of the game!

Check it out!!!!!


[previewyoutube="eQPyMJ5p2EY;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube]
















That's it for now! Thanks for being so awesome.



Daver The Dave
